title: Control plane: add pause/resume API for provisioning runs (admin-only) + audit logs
author: Gabe Wilson
body: Context: Operators need a safe way to intervene during long or noisy Dedicated pool bring-ups without cancelling a provisioning run (e.g., to wait for quota approval, replace a bad node, or coordinate a customer window). This PR adds API support for pausing/resuming provisioning runs, with admin-only access controls and audit logging for compliance/incident traceability. What’s in this PR: (1) New endpoints: POST /v1/fleet/provisioning-runs/{run_id}:pause and POST /v1/fleet/provisioning-runs/{run_id}:resume. Endpoints are idempotent: pausing an already-paused run returns 200 with the current paused state; resuming a non-paused run returns 409. (2) State machine: add Paused as a first-class terminal-ish state in the persisted run state machine. Allowed transitions: Provisioning|Imaging|Bootstrapping|Validating -> Paused; Paused -> (previous_stage) with run_state restoring the last non-paused stage. Disallowed transitions: Ready/Failed/Canceled cannot be paused or resumed. (3) Concurrency safety: pause/resume uses optimistic locking on run_version to prevent racing with stage workers; stage workers check paused_at before starting work and before committing stage completion. (4) Audit logs: emit audit events provisioning.run.paused and provisioning.run.resumed with actor_id, actor_email (redacted in storage), run_id, pool_id, previous_state, reason, and request_id/correlation_id. Audit events are written to the central audit sink and also appended to provisioning_run_events for easier debugging in the control plane UI. (5) AuthZ: endpoints are restricted to admin-only principals (permission: fleet.provisioning.admin). Non-admins receive 403; service-to-service principals are allowed only if explicitly granted the admin scope. (6) API surface updates: ProvisioningRun resource now includes paused_at, paused_by, pause_reason (truncated to 512 chars), and last_state_before_pause. (7) Tests: unit tests for transition rules and idempotency; integration tests to ensure workers stop progressing when paused; security test coverage for authz failures. Rollout/compatibility: Backward compatible for existing callers; new fields are additive. Paused is treated as non-ready by routing (already enforced by Ready gating) and does not emit Ready transitions. Follow-ups: CLI wiring is in a separate PR (ENG-2750/ENG-2751) so we can iterate on API semantics first; dashboard widgets for Paused counts/time-in-paused will follow in observability pack work. Screenshots/logs: See example audit record in the PR discussion; run events show pause/resume with correlation IDs.
commits: control-plane/provisioning: add Pause/Resume RPCs + REST routes
provisioning state machine: introduce Paused state + transition guards
audit: emit provisioning pause/resume audit events (with redaction + truncation)
authz: enforce fleet.provisioning.admin on pause/resume endpoints
workers: respect paused_at before stage execution + commit
tests: add integration coverage for pause/resume + optimistic locking
checks: buildkite/redwood-monorepo (integration): PASS (rerun; initial failure due to flaky DNS test unrelated to this PR)
conversation: Ethan Park (2025-03-06 14:12): API shape looks good. Two questions: (1) should resume return the run in the restored stage (e.g., Bootstrapping) or remain Paused until the worker picks it up? (2) can you make pause/resume idempotent so the CLI can be dumb? Also please document which states can be paused.

Gabe Wilson (2025-03-06 15:01): Good call. I updated it so resume immediately restores last_state_before_pause (so UI/ops see the intent right away), but workers still gate on paused_at so they won’t progress until that clears. Both endpoints are now idempotent: pause on Paused -> 200 w/ unchanged; resume on non-paused -> 409. Added an allowed-state table to the route docstring and to the OpenAPI description.

Rafael Mendes (2025-03-06 16:27): From SRE perspective: we need a hard guarantee that workers won’t commit stage completion after pause is set (race). Please add a check in the worker right before writing stage completion + a store-level guard if possible. Also +1 on optimistic locking.

Gabe Wilson (2025-03-06 18:05): Implemented double-check: worker verifies paused_at both pre-execution and pre-commit. Store write path now enforces: if paused_at is non-null, reject stage updates with 409 unless update_type is pause/resume/cancel. Added integration test that pauses mid-validation and ensures no stage transition occurs after pause.

Kevin Osei (2025-03-07 09:10): Security review: (1) audit log should not store full actor_email; either hash or store the org user id only. (2) pause_reason can include customer names; please cap length and ensure it’s not exported to general logs. (3) permissions: make sure this is admin-only, not just “operator”.

Gabe Wilson (2025-03-07 11:02): Addressed: actor_email is now redacted at rest (stored as domain + last 4 of hash for debugging), and raw email is only in the in-memory event payload sent to the audit sink (which already handles PII). pause_reason is truncated to 512 and explicitly excluded from structured info logs; it is only present in audit + provisioning_run_events table. Permission is fleet.provisioning.admin; added negative tests for operator role.

Benji Okafor (2025-03-07 13:40): Can we make the 409s consistent? Right now resume when Ready returns 400, resume when Provisioning returns 409. Suggest 409 for all invalid transitions and include current_state + allowed_transitions in the error details (without leaking reason).

Gabe Wilson (2025-03-07 14:25): Updated error handling: all invalid transitions return 409 with {current_state, attempted_action, allowed_actions}. pause_reason is not echoed back. Added tests to lock it down.
Ethan Park (2025-03-08 10:18): Final pass: please add a note about routing semantics (Paused is never routable) and ensure the protobuf has comments. Otherwise LGTM.
Gabe Wilson (2025-03-08 10:46): Added comments in proto + doc note in route handler. Thanks.
Rafael Mendes (2025-03-08 11:03): Approved. This is the behavior we need for pilot ops. Please make sure runbook references land in docs/Confluence later.
Kevin Osei (2025-03-08 11:20): Approved with the redaction/truncation changes. Good to proceed.
release_notes: Added admin-only pause/resume endpoints for Dedicated provisioning runs with audit logging and worker-side gating to prevent state races.
